services.name: Private Rental Space
services.desc: The beautiful Front Yadkin ARts District (YARD) space provides a comfortable, laid back environment while allowing guests plenty of space to socialize and celebrate. The versatility of the room makes it the perfect location for a bridal shower, baby shower, work or organizational meeting, or even a dinner party! No matter what you need the space for, we can provide the perfect accommodations and ambience! The fee is $35 per hour (with a 2 hour minimum) for all Front Yard rentals. This fee is based on up to 6 hours, after that the fee is $235 for the day (which will give you up to 12 consecutive hours). Rental fee is to be paid in full at the time of your registration. Please call or email
